children: According to Minkabu, HKET and FTV News, surging oil prices unsettled investors ahead of the weekend and concerns over heavy debt at technology companies weighed on sentiment, as U.S. stocks closed lower across the board on Friday and major Asian index futures fell in night trading.

Nikkei 225 futures for December 2026 delivery on the Osaka Exchange ended the night session at 63,630, down 1,890 points from the previous settlement and 1,694.29 points below the Nikkei 225 cash close of 65,324.29, with 13,825 contracts traded. TOPIX futures stood at 4,027.5, down 54 points.

Hang Seng Index futures closed the night session at 24,112, down 47 points. HKEX data showed the October contract trading between 24,091 and 24,273 in after-hours trading, with volume of 12,335 contracts. The NASDAQ Golden Dragon China Index fell 1.3% to 5,695. Among ADRs, HSBC ADR was equivalent to HK$148.45, 0.84% below its Hong Kong close; Tencent ADR was at HK$414.01, down 0.91%; Meituan ADR was at HK$75.66, down 0.05%; and Alibaba's U.S. shares were equivalent to HK$107.04, 1.61% below the Hong Kong close.

TAIEX futures fell 1,144 points, or 2.42%, to 46,140 in the night session. Mini TAIEX futures ended at 46,141, down 1,143 points, while electronics sector futures closed at 2,875.45, down 87.65 points. TSMC futures closed at 2,384, down 47 points.

title: ASIA NIGHT SESSION | Nikkei Futures Fall 1,890 Points, TAIEX Futures Drop 2.42% in Night Trading
